meta.name: lark-workflow-meeting-summary
meta.description: 会议纪要整理工作流：汇总指定时间范围内的会议纪要并生成结构化报告。当用户需要整理会议纪要、生成会议周报、回顾一段时间内的会议内容时使用。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按时间段汇总会议纪要并生成结构化报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常需整理团队会议记录并定期产出摘要
copy.tagline_en: Summarize meeting notes into a structured report for a time range
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to compile meeting notes into reports

howto.what: 将指定时间范围内的会议纪要汇总成结构化报告：单日输出“今日会议概览”，多日输出“会议纪要周报”，列出会议时间、主题、纪要链接及逐字稿获取方式。
howto.when: 当用户要求整理会议纪要、生成会议周报、回顾一段时间内的会议内容时使用；默认汇总过去7天。

say.text: 帮我整理这周的会议纪要
say.note: 将本周会议纪要整理成周报
汇总上周会议并输出结构化周报

howto.what_en: Consolidates meeting minutes from a specified time range into a structured report: single-day outputs 'Today's Meeting Overview', multi-day outputs 'Weekly Meeting Summary', listing time, topic, minute links, and transcript source method.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to organize meeting minutes, generate a weekly meeting report, or review past meetings; defaults to the last 7 days.

say_en.text: Please organize this week's meeting minutes.
say_en.note: Creates a weekly summary for this week.
Summarizes last week's meetings into a report.

say_en.text: What meetings did we have today?
